fields.name: Cardiology
fields.description:
Cardiology is the medical focused on the diagnosis,
treatment, and prevention of diseases affecting the heart and
blood vessels, including heart disease, hypertension,
arrhythmia, and heart failure.

fields.name: Radiology
fields.description:
Radiology is a medical specialty that uses advanced imaging
technologies such as X-rays, CT scans, MRI, and ultrasound
to diagnose and monitor diseases and injuries.

fields.name: Neurology
fields.description:
Neurology focuses on the diagnosis and treatment of disorders
affecting the brain, spinal cord, nerves, and muscles, including
migraine, epilepsy, stroke, Parkinson's disease, and other
neurological conditions.

fields.name: Dermatology
fields.description:
Dermatology focuses on the diagnosis and treatment of conditions
affecting the skin, hair, and nails, including acne, eczema,
psoriasis, skin infections, and hair loss.

fields.name: Orthopedics
fields.description:
Orthopedics focuses on the diagnosis and treatment of conditions
affecting the bones, joints, muscles, ligaments, and tendons,
including fractures, arthritis, sports injuries, and joint problems.

fields.name: Pediatrics
fields.description: Pediatrics provides medical care for infants, children, and adolescents, focusing on their growth, development, illnesses, vaccinations, and overall preventive healthcare.

fields.name: Gastroenterology
fields.description: Gastroenterology focuses on the diagnosis and treatment of disorders affecting the digestive system, including the stomach, intestines, liver, pancreas, and gallbladder.

fields.name: Gynecology
fields.description: Gynecology focuses on the  treatment of the female reproductive system

fields.name: Ophthalmology
fields.description: Ophthalmology focuses on the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of eye disorders to maintain healthy vision.

fields.name: Oncology
fields.description: Diagnosis, treatment, and supportive care for cancer patients.

fields.name: Urology
fields.description: Specialized care for kidneys, bladder, prostate, and urinary conditions.

fields.name: Physiotherapy
fields.description: Personalized therapy to restore movement, strength, and physical function.
